Sap. 2, 18.''}}* He tru{{ls}}ted in God: let him novv deliuer him if he vvill: for he {{ls}}aid, That I am the {{ls}}onne of God. {{verse|chapter=27|verse=44}} And the {{ls}}elf {{ls}}ame thing the theeues al{{ls}}o that were crucified vvith him, reproched him vvithal.

{{verse|chapter=27|verse=45}} And from the {{ls}}ixt houre, there vvas darkene{{ls}}{{ls}}e made vpon the vvhole earth, vntil the ninthe houre. {{verse|chapter=27|verse=46}} And about the ninthe houre {{sc|Iesvs}} cried vvith a mighty voice, {{ls}}aying, ''Eli, Eli, lamma-{{ls}}abacthani''? that is, ''My God, my God, {{sup|‖}} vvhy ha{{ls}}t thou for{{ls}}aken me''? {{verse|chapter=27|verse=47}} And certaine that {{ls}}toode there and heard, {{ls}}aid, He calleth Elias. {{verse|chapter=27|verse=48}} And incontinent one of them running, tooke a {{ls}}ponge, & filled it vvith vinegre: and put it on a reede, and gaue him to drinke. {{verse|chapter=27|verse=49}} And other {{ls}}aid, Let be, let vs {{ls}}ee vvhether Elias come to deliuer him. {{verse|chapter=27|verse=50}} And {{sc|Iesvs}} againe crying vvith a mighty voice, yelded vp the gho{{ls}}t. {{verse|chapter=27|verse=51}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text={{sc|Hora nona}} in the Churches Seruice.}}And be hold the vele of the temple vvas rent in tvvo peeces, from the toppe euen to the botome. and the earth did quake, and the rockes vvere rent, {{verse|chapter=27|verse=52}} and the graues vvere opened: and many bodies of the {{ls}}aincts that had {{ls}}lept, ro{{ls}}e. {{verse|chapter=27|verse=53}} And they going forth out of the graues after his re{{ls}}urrection, came into the holy citie: and appeared to many. {{verse|chapter=27|verse=54}} And the Centurion and they that vvere vvith him vvatching {{sc|Iesvs}}, hauing {{ls}}een the earth-quake and the things that vvere done, vvere {{ls}}ore afraid, {{ls}}aying, In deede this vvas the {{ls}}onne of God.

{{verse|chapter=27|verse=55}} And there vvere there many vvomen a farre of, vvhich had folovved {{sc|Iesvs}} from Galilee, mini{{ls}}tring vnto him: {{verse|chapter=27|verse=56}} among vvhom vvas Marie Magdalene, and Marie the mother of Iames and Io{{ls}}eph, and the mother of the {{ls}}onnes of Zebedee. {{verse|chapter=27|verse=57}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text={{sc|Hora vesperarvm}}, or, Euen{{ls}}ong.}}And vvhen it vvas euening, there came a certaine<noinclude>{{continues|rich}}</noinclude>
